description: This file defines an interface ShoppingCartFacade serving as an abstraction layer between core shopping cart models and web controllers. It provides methods for adding, retrieving, updating, and deleting shopping cart data and items, facilitating interaction with shopping cart objects and customer/mall entities within an e-commerce application.

methods.name: addItemsToShoppingCart
methods.description: Adds an item to the specified shopping cart data, returning updated ShoppingCartData.

methods.name: createCartModel
methods.description: Creates a new ShoppingCart object based on a shopping cart code, store, and customer.

methods.name: getShoppingCartData
methods.description: Retrieves shopping cart data using customer and store information or by shopping cart ID or code.

methods.name: removeCartItem
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart by item ID and cart ID.

methods.name: updateCartItem
methods.description: Updates the quantity of an item in the cart.

methods.name: deleteShoppingCart
methods.description: Deletes the shopping cart identified by ID or code.

methods.name: updateCartItems
methods.description: Updates multiple cart items at once.

methods.name: getShoppingCartModel
methods.description: Retrieves a ShoppingCart model instance based on store and customer information.
